body:
## Pull request overview

This PR unifies version numbers across the ObjectStack monorepo by bumping the root package.json from 3.0.7 to 3.0.8 and updating all package version references in the ROADMAP.md documentation to match the 38 individual packages that were already at 3.0.8.

**Changes:**
- Root monorepo version bumped from 3.0.7 to 3.0.8 to align with all workspace packages
- ROADMAP.md updated with current version 3.0.8 in header and all 34 entries in Package Status Matrix
- Changeset added to track the version unification as a patch release

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 3 out of 3 changed files in this pull request and generated 1 comment.

| File | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| package.json | Bumped root monorepo version from 3.0.7 to 3.0.8 |
| ROADMAP.md | Updated header version and all 34 package entries in the status matrix to 3.0.8 |
| .changeset/unify-versions.md | Added patch changeset for `@objectstack/spec` to document the version unification |

The Package Status Matrix is missing an entry for `@objectstack/service-automation`. This package exists at version 3.0.8 (in packages/services/service-automation/package.json) and has 67 tests according to other references in this ROADMAP file. It should be added to maintain accuracy of the matrix.

The entry should be inserted after line 810 (service-feed) to maintain alphabetical grouping of service packages.
```suggestion
| `@objectstack/service-feed` | 3.0.8 | 40 | ✅ Stable | 7/10 |
| `@objectstack/service-automation` | 3.0.8 | 67 | ✅ Stable | 7/10 |
```
